taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-14 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 161.1 | 3.39 | 3.39
2 | 1022.2 | 1.76 | 5.15
3 | 85.2 | 1.93 | 7.08
4 | 88.8 | 9.77 | 16.85
5 | 117.4 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-14
Curve type: KHA (5-layer combination curve)
Aquifer depth: 7.08 – 16.85 m
Recommendation: Target drilling and screen placement within the 7.08–16.85 m interval (moderate-resistivity Layer 4, ~88.8 ohm-m, ~9.77 m thick), which is the most probable water-bearing zone; case off the overlying low-resistivity Layer 3 (85.2 ohm-m) to prevent clay/fine-sediment influx, and consider extending the borehole slightly deeper to verify the resistivity increase in Layer 5 as a possible secondary aquifer/bedrock contact.
